title: Campfire More
description: Makes a range of odd blocks campfire compatible.
body:
Lets you cook a bunch more blocks and items on campfires
This includes-
- dyed blocks into undyed varients
- leaves into leaf litter
- raw materials into ingot form
- rotten flesh into leather
- logs into charcoal
- mud into clay
- book into paper
- candle become honeycomb
- sponge become dry
- smol mushroom become big mushroom
